name: cleric
lore:
A cleric is no mere village priest bound to a dusty altar; they are the living conduits of the divine, thriving wherever their deity’s mandate is challenged. In the ecology of the adventuring party, they serve as the vital anchor, bridging the gap between the mundane and the celestial. You will find them clad in both vestments and steel, for their faith is a militant one.

Their behavior is marked by a terrifying certainty. While others study or bargain for power, the cleric breathes it through prayer and ritual. They are the shepherds of the soul and the hammers of faith, manifesting miracles not through personal ego, but through absolute submission to a higher will. Whether mending a broken limb or calling down the sun’s fury, every gesture is a verse in a grand, cosmic liturgy. Respect the cleric, for they do not merely believe—they *know*.
